decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line bug-fix entry in the changelog [ev-b4198e6a82a9]. It says lifecycler configs now reference a valid IPv6 address and port combination, but not what was wrong before, which configurations or deployments were affected, or what an operator sees after upgrading. None of the other items in the same Bug Fixes section adds context. Without the PR #11121 or commit 6385b19 details (for example, whether IPv6 lifecycler addresses used to be malformed and failed, and whether existing configs behave differently now), the evidence does not support the proposed behavior-change consequence or its statement that "previous invalid references" were fixed.
